novel_features.name: Cross-engine citation check
novel_features.description: See whether ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Gemini and the Google AI Overview cite a domain for a prompt, with the source positions, in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Runs the prompt on each engine in parallel and matches the domain against each engine's cited sources; no endpoint compares engines.
novel_features.example: cloro-pp-cli cited nike.com --prompt "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US --engines aimode,gemini --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when the question is whether a site is cited for a prompt, not what the answers say.

narrative.headline: ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini answers with their cited sources, Google results with the AI Overview, and a citation check across engines.
narrative.value_prop: Each engine is a typed command and an MCP tool: chatgpt, aimode, gemini, google (with --include-aioverview) and news, geo-targeted by country. The cited command runs one prompt on several engines in parallel and tells you which of them cite your domain, and at which source positions.

quickstart.comment: Check the install and config without spending credits

quickstart.command: cloro-pp-cli chatgpt --prompt "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US
quickstart.comment: A ChatGPT answer with its cited sources (7 credits)

quickstart.command: cloro-pp-cli google --query "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US --include-aioverview
quickstart.comment: Google results with the AI Overview (7 credits)

quickstart.command: cloro-pp-cli cited nike.com --prompt "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US
quickstart.comment: Which engines cite a domain for the prompt (26 credits for all four engines)

troubleshoots.fix: Check the balance with cloro-pp-cli credits, then add credits in the dashboard or check fewer engines per cited run
Wait for running requests to finish, or send bulk work through cloro-pp-cli async batch

troubleshoots.symptom: A Google result link is empty or a google.com/goto URL
troubleshoots.fix: Pass its redirectLink to cloro-pp-cli goto --url <redirectLink>

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when a task needs the live answer of ChatGPT, Google AI Mode or Gemini with the sources it cites, Google results with the AI Overview, or Google News, for a given country. Use cited to check whether a domain is cited for a prompt across engines. Each scrape spends credits, so prefer one targeted call over many.
anti_triggers: Plain web search where answer engines and the AI Overview do not matter; a cheaper SERP API fits better
Historical rank or citation trends; this CLI returns live results and keeps no history
Crawling or rendering arbitrary web pages

recipes.title: ChatGPT sources only
recipes.command: cloro-pp-cli chatgpt --prompt "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US --agent --select result.sources.url,result.sources.position
recipes.explanation: Keep only the cited URLs and their positions from a large answer payload.

recipes.title: AI Overview sources for a keyword
recipes.command: cloro-pp-cli google --query "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US --include-aioverview --agent --select result.aioverview.sources.url
recipes.explanation: Read which pages the Google AI Overview cites.

recipes.title: Citation check on two engines
recipes.command: cloro-pp-cli cited nike.com --prompt "best running shoes for flat feet" --country US --engines aimode,gemini --agent
recipes.explanation: Run fewer engines to spend fewer credits.
